name: Customers
description: Priority customer mirror (read-only for the agent)
technicalDescription: Since 27.10 the credit-insurance and obligo fields live in CreditCovers, CustomerExposure and ExposureItems (moved from obligoUsed, obligoPct, creditInsurer, insuranceApprovedAmount, insurerCaseNumber). creditLimit stays: it is Priority's own credit limit, not the insured limit. Mirror vs enrichment (plan 04.11): the morning pull (PullPriorityCustomers) upserts by customerCode and writes ONLY the Priority columns, listed explicitly in code: customerName, customerType, priorityStatus, paymentTermsDays, paymentTermsLabel, creditLimit, salesAgentName, salesAgentPhone, apContact*, procurementContact*, primaryEmail, priceListCode, ledgerBalance, address, paymentMethod, companyId (only when Priority has one), source, syncedAt. Our columns (checkRemittanceMail, remittanceSenders, assignedBookkeeperName, preferredChannel, doNotContact, collectionStage, internalNotes, collectionNote, companyId when Priority has none) are never overwritten. A customer that disappears from Priority is never deleted: priorityStatus becomes לא פעיל בפריוריטי, so CustomerNotes and OpenMovements keep their link. Calc layer (6b): openBalance, openDebit, onAccountCredit, overdueAmount, oldestDueDate, openMovementCount, movementsSyncedAt, documentCount, lastDocumentDate, aggregatesAt are written ONLY by RefreshCustomerAggregates / PullOpenMovements (movementsSyncedAt); no sync writes them. Money truth = the ledger (memories/files/FINANCE_MODEL.md).

columns.name: customerType

columns.name: paymentTermsDays
columns.description: Payment terms in days: 30/45/60/90/120

columns.name: paymentTermsLabel
columns.description: Terms label, e.g. שוטף+60

columns.name: creditLimit
columns.description: Credit limit ILS

columns.name: salesAgentName
columns.description: Sales agent name

columns.name: salesAgentPhone
columns.description: Sales agent phone

columns.name: apContactName
columns.description: Customer accounts-payable contact name

columns.name: apContactEmail
columns.description: AP contact email

columns.name: apContactPhone
columns.description: AP contact phone

columns.name: procurementContactName
columns.description: Procurement contact name

columns.name: procurementContactEmail
columns.description: Procurement contact email

columns.name: procurementContactPhone
columns.description: Procurement contact phone

columns.name: assignedBookkeeperName
columns.description: Assigned bookkeeper name

columns.name: preferredChannel
columns.description: Preferred contact channel

columns.name: doNotContact
columns.description: Do not contact this customer

columns.name: collectionStage
columns.description: Current collection stage

columns.name: lastPaymentDate
columns.description: Date of last payment

columns.name: internalNotes
columns.description: Internal notes (long text)

columns.name: source
columns.description: Data source: priority-mock, priority-file (uploaded Priority export), priority-api, or test-fixture (marked test data, removed by DeleteTestFixtures)

columns.name: syncedAt
columns.description: When this row was last synced from Priority

columns.name: companyId
columns.description: Company registration number (ח״פ) from Priority. Every insurer (בסס״ח) request is sent by it; missing → no request, a task להשלים ח.פ instead

columns.name: checkRemittanceMail
columns.description: Flag בודקים פירוט במייל: only for flagged customers the receipts matching searches mail for a remittance, and only from remittanceSenders. Flag on with no sender = configuration error, customer skipped

columns.name: remittanceSenders
columns.description: Remittance sender addresses for this customer, comma-separated (one or more). Searched only when checkRemittanceMail is on

columns.name: primaryEmail
columns.description: General email on the Priority customer card

columns.name: priceListCode
columns.description: Customer price list code in Priority

columns.name: ledgerBalance
columns.description: Customer ledger balance ILS from Priority

columns.name: address
columns.description: Customer billing address from the Priority customer card (street, city), sent as BUYER_ADDRESS on an insurer request

columns.name: paymentMethod
columns.description: From Priority: how the customer usually pays (העברה, צ׳ק, צ׳קים דחויים, אשראי…). Shown in the aging report

columns.name: collectionNote
columns.description: From Priority: the customer's standing collection note, e.g. "משלמים ב-30 לחודש". Shown in the aging report

columns.name: priorityKey
columns.description: Sync: Priority natural key (CUSTNAME = customerCode). Written only by SyncFromBrain.

columns.name: sourceUpdatedAt
columns.description: Sync: last change time in Priority when the source reports one, else null.

columns.name: syncRunId
columns.description: Sync: SyncRuns.runId of the run that last wrote this row.

columns.name: lastAppWriteAt
columns.description: Sync: when the app last wrote this row to Priority (write-through). A sync whose Brain data is older skips the row.

columns.name: pendingBrainConfirm
columns.description: Sync: true after an app write-through until a Brain sync newer than lastAppWriteAt confirms it.

columns.name: deletedInSource
columns.description: Sync: true when a fully-read Brain table no longer contains this key. Row and enrichment are kept.

columns.name: obligoLimit
columns.description: Mirror: maximum obligo in Priority (CUSTOMERS.MAX_OBLIGO), ILS

columns.name: creditInsuredAmount
columns.description: Mirror: credit-insurance amount recorded in Priority (CUSTOMERS.ZMET_CREDITINSURAMNT), ILS

columns.name: priorityOwner
columns.description: Mirror: Priority user who owns the customer card (CUSTOMERS.OWNERLOGIN)

columns.name: paymentTermsCode
columns.description: Mirror: payment terms code (CUSTOMERS.PAYCODE)

columns.name: salesAgentCode
columns.description: Mirror: sales agent code (CUSTOMERS.AGENTCODE)

columns.name: openBalance
columns.description: Calc (RefreshCustomerAggregates): sum of OpenMovements.amount, ILS. Null = ledger not read yet

columns.name: openDebit
columns.description: Calc: sum of positive OpenMovements amounts

columns.name: onAccountCredit
columns.description: Calc: sum of קבלה movements (receipts left on account), negative

columns.name: overdueAmount
columns.description: Calc: positive movements with dueDate before asOf (AgentSettings balanceAsOfDate, else today)

columns.name: oldestDueDate
columns.description: Calc: earliest dueDate of the customer's open movements

columns.name: openMovementCount
columns.description: Calc: number of open movements

columns.name: movementsSyncedAt
columns.description: Calc: when PullOpenMovements last completed this customer's ledger read

columns.name: documentCount
columns.description: Calc: number of Invoices rows of the customer

columns.name: lastDocumentDate
columns.description: Calc: latest Invoices.invoiceDate of the customer

columns.name: aggregatesAt
columns.description: Calc: when RefreshCustomerAggregates last computed this row
